tactics:
induction l generalizing l' i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases l' with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b bs =>
      cases i with
      | zero => simp [-List.getElem_zipWith, List.zipWith]
      | succ k => simp only [List.zipWith, List.getElem_cons_succ]; exact ih bs k _
induction l generalizing l' i <;> cases l' <;> cases i <;> simp_all [-List.getElem_zipWith, List.zipWith]
induction l generalizing l' i <;> cases l' <;> cases i <;> simp [-List.getElem_zipWith, List.zipWith] at * <;> grind
